features.title: Multi-Source Spatial Intelligence and Telemetry Platform
acceptance: Ingests orbital satellite telemetry, aircraft positions, RF sensors, and public traffic camera feeds with health verification
Provides viewport queries and camera state persistence for saved and favourite locations
Executes trajectory anomaly detection with ground-truth ML benchmark evaluation
Synthesizes verified analyst workflow macros with deterministic candidate detection and drift demotion
Enforces OIDC/PKCE authentication with Keycloak and local demo mode rejection in production

features.title: Hardware SDR and SondeHub Web Receiver Integration
acceptance: Local USB WebUSB/WebAudio SDR receiver direct streaming for ADS-B and FM broadcast
Direct SondeHub radiosonde telemetry layer with balloon flight prediction vectors

features.title: Multimodal Voice Assistant and Speech-to-Text Navigation
acceptance: Bidirectional voice commanding via Gemini Live and Whisper/Ollama local models
Hands-free camera fly-to and entity investigation speech tools
